items.title: Matrix shell
items.text: Phase one. Clean command surface online. Historical kernel remains archived.

items.title: Engine bridge
items.text: Phase two. Family, audit, watchdog and engine probes connected.

items.title: Bloodline graph
items.text: Phase three. Interactive House graph and remembrance nodes are live.

items.title: Liturgy binding
items.text: Phase four. Liturgy follows the selected bloodline node. Roster sealed.

items.title: House walk
items.text: Phase five. The circle is named in generation order, Chirombe to the future.

items.title: Liturgy ledger
items.text: Phase six. Dated House walks can be replayed from the audit ledger.

items.title: Prayer chamber
items.text: Phase seven. Advanced prayers can be written, sealed and declared. Protection drone is available.

items.title: Watch device
items.text: Phase eight. Watch Device mode holds the night screen and broadcasts prayers with system updates.
